review.headline: Easy 9 km done at a steady 5:42/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band and at a conversational heart rate.
observations: Distance 8.99 km against 9.0 planned, so the volume target was met.
Average pace 5:42/km sits in the middle of the easy range; every km split was 342 s, showing very even pacing.
Average HR 138 with max 141 and cadence 174 spm indicate a relaxed, aerobic effort.
Efficiency 1.273 is close to the 4-week easy average of 138 bpm and 342 s/km, so no drift from baseline.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so perceived effort is unconfirmed.
Weekly volume is far behind plan (16.99 km done of 42 planned in week 1) and CTL has fallen from 43 to 26.7, though this run itself was executed well.
